notes.title: Beta Test Version is now Out
notes.notes:
[b]Beta test version is now out ![/b]
you can test the very last version of the game before the next Major Update
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37795546/b8a5647cdab3091974df8b7f18f7c3e3a4fcc3fd.png[/img]

[b]Changes :[/b]
- Boss Phases include new weapon and Skill for the boss 
- Boss difficulty has been increased
- Maximum Wave is now 100 instead of 50


Boss Sky Burst :
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37795546/c42864fa8772b0cdfa63b83ef3f800aea02e9ee3.png[/img]


[b]Added :[/b]
- New head : God
- New Body Module : Hornets
- New Boss Attack : Death Shot
- New Boss Attack : Sky Burst
- Coop Multiplayer now up to 3 players

3 players Coop :
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37795546/406966bae9802440b0035427734c69472817c3d2.png[/img]

- New Boss Attack : Sunrise
- New Boss Attack : Bull Charge
- Enemies Spawn system V2
- Drone System

notes.title: Dynarog V1.3
notes.notes:
[b]Added :[/b]
- Multi Coop Local
- New Weapon : Burst
- New Weapon : Ultra Burst
- New Module : Quick shot
- New Head System that allow player to change his head and base Stats
- Selection menu to let the player chose the start Head and Custom Color for the Robot

Selection Menu :
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37795546/c269986635cbbc895a630dbfe0e9f42e9f705c5d.png[/img]

Heads must be unlocked to be equiped
New Heads :
- Bullet Bill
- Billy
- Pyramid Head
- Exhaust Head
- Pokeball
- Bullet head
- Lord
- Kavendrus
- Spike head
- Voyager
- 404
- Morningstar
- Devil
- WallE

Workshop :
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37795546/9fb02ef3c56cf19c338a1ad0dda597de1cdb88cc.png[/img]

[b]Changes :[/b]
- Arena rework
- Level system and Healer are disable, replaced by a dedicated Workshop
- Infinite Run mode disable (Rework in progress)
- Ennemies now drop more Octet
- Boss Attack from a shorter distance
- Prices has been ajusted
- Enemies difficulty has been reworked
- Life loss during bloody hell mode is disable during Boss phase

Coop :
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37795546/df784a749571ed7d4f4a919a375e6618bff1e66e.png[/img]

[b]Solved :[/b]
- weapons and modules wern't mark has "Out of stock" for some reasons
- Attack and weapon reload is no more blocked when the combo is between X2 and X1

[b]Remaining bugs :[/b]
- some Multi issues
- Controler issues when having multiples Gamepad connected
